revision_clock.backfill: existing subjects start with a positive opaque revision
advances_on: topic core lifecycle moderation fields and soft delete
reply core lifecycle structural fields and soft delete

application.idempotency: PortContext idempotency key equals decision UUID
application.revision_rule: exact reviewed Forum moderation subject revision must match before mutation
application.revision_locking: active subject row and moderation revision row are transactionally fenced before application
application.sqlite_locking: writer reservation uses the dedicated moderation revision row
application.success: Forum mutation, required Forum root/projection events and shared completed receipt commit in one transaction

host_materialization.owner_selection: ModerationModule must be present in ModuleRegistry when mod-moderation is selected
host_materialization.factory_timing: materialize only after HostRuntimeContext exists and Forum host facts have been composed
host_materialization.moderation_without_forum: materialize an empty subject adapter registry
host_materialization.forum_without_moderation: Forum remains available and its neutral factories remain unmaterialized
host_materialization.materialization_failure: fail host composition; never fall back to another adapter or imply applied

owner_application_operation.identity: tenant + immutable decision UUID/hash + exact reviewed subject
owner_application_operation.atomic_enqueue: decision, typed effect, pending operation, case_decided event and Moderation command receipt share one owner transaction
owner_application_operation.typed_effect_backfill: existing decisions are backfilled only when moderation_decision_effects exists; legacy effect None decisions remain non-dispatchable
owner_application_operation.lease: bounded CAS claim with attempt counter, expiry and fresh UUID lease token; expired applying leases are reclaimable
owner_application_operation.applied_evidence: ModerationDecisionApplication must match decision and exact reviewed subject identity before applied revision/time are stored

dispatch.scope: one exact due tenant/decision operation per call; no polling loop
dispatch.command: reconstruct from immutable Moderation decision/effect/case and exact operation subject/hash
dispatch.adapter_lookup: exact materialized registry key subject_module + subject_kind; no fallback
dispatch.domain_idempotency: immutable decision UUID; lease token is attempt/correlation identity only
dispatch.non_retryable_conflict_or_invariant: operator_review, including stale reviewed revision conflicts
dispatch.invalid_success_evidence: operator_review while the live lease is still held
dispatch.owner_storage_failure_after_claim: return owner error and rely on lease expiry/reclaim; never forge a domain result

shared_scheduler.candidate_discovery: read-only earliest due Moderation application row across tenants; at most one candidate per scheduler pass per host
shared_scheduler.durable_claim: dispatch_application_operation_once remains the sole authoritative Moderation operation CAS before domain dispatch
shared_scheduler.generic_envelope_token: scheduler-only token; never used as Moderation operation lease or domain idempotency key
shared_scheduler.multi_host: duplicate candidate discovery converges on the existing Moderation CAS; losing hosts perform no domain mutation
shared_scheduler.completion: generic ModuleWorkSource completion is a no-op because moderation_application_operations is the durable outcome source
shared_scheduler.shutdown: shared deployment StopHandle prevents new claims while already claimed module work is allowed to finish
shared_scheduler.bespoke_loop: forbidden; Moderation does not add its own tokio spawn or polling interval

audit_lifecycle.scope: atomic lifecycle applies to claims/finalizers executed after this source is active
audit_lifecycle.claim: winning operation CAS and first case decided -> applying_decision transition share one owner transaction; reclaim while already applying_decision does not bump the case revision
audit_lifecycle.retryable: operation retry scheduling and application_retry_scheduled audit share one owner transaction while the case remains applying_decision
audit_lifecycle.applied: operation applied evidence, case applying_decision -> closed, closed_at, active deduplication key release, application_applied and case_closed share one owner transaction
audit_lifecycle.rejected: operation rejected, case applying_decision -> escalated, application_rejected and case_escalated share one owner transaction
audit_lifecycle.operator_review: operation operator_review, case applying_decision -> escalated, application_operator_review and case_escalated share one owner transaction
audit_lifecycle.active_case_identity: released only on closed; preserved on escalated for operator work and report attachment
audit_lifecycle.legacy_terminal_rows: pre-audit applied/rejected/operator_review rows are terminal truth and are reconciled explicitly by the Moderation owner without domain application or fabricated historical lifecycle facts
audit_lifecycle.public_event_contract: not frozen; moderation_events remains an internal owner audit ledger rather than a typed cross-domain rustok-events family

operator_recovery.actor: human PortActorKind User with UUID identity
operator_recovery.receipt: existing moderation command receipt ledger; request identity binds actor, decision ID, expected case revision and bounded reason
operator_recovery.same_decision_requeue: only rejected or operator_review may move to retryable due now; applied can never be requeued
operator_recovery.requeue_case: escalated or legacy pre-audit decided moves to applying_decision with exact expected revision CAS
operator_recovery.immutable_identity: decision UUID/hash/reviewed subject remain unchanged; next domain attempt still comes only from the shared scheduler and one-attempt dispatcher
operator_recovery.legacy_terminal_reconciliation: applied maps to closed; rejected/operator_review map to escalated; already-consistent terminal case is a no-op
operator_recovery.applied_reconciliation_evidence: stored applied_revision must be at least reviewed revision and stored applied_at must exist
operator_recovery.reconciliation_time: a legacy applied case closes at current reconciliation time; stored historical applied_at is evidence, not a fabricated case closure timestamp
operator_recovery.re_review: stale reviewed revision requires a new case and new immutable decision using a freshly authorized producer revision; old decision is never retargeted
operator_recovery.authorized_transport: host-owned apps/server GraphQL transport requires tenant match, human user principal, moderation_cases:override effective authority, enabled moderation module and non-nil root idempotency
operator_recovery.fresh_revision_rereview: authorized GraphQL workflow composes read + open_case + assign_case + decide_case with deterministic receipt identities to create a new case and immutable decision at an explicit newer producer revision

supported_effects: permanent Lock for forum_topic using TopicService::set_locked_in_tx
SetVisibility Hidden for forum_post using exact Forum ReplyStatus::Hidden lifecycle semantics
SetVisibility Removed for forum_post using the complete Forum ReplyService::remove_in_tx soft-delete owner path
RejectPublication for forum_post using exact Forum ReplyStatus::Rejected moderator publication semantics

reply_hidden_semantics.already_hidden: no-op without duplicate counters or ForumReplyStatusChanged event
reply_hidden_semantics.other_valid_to_hidden_transitions: status change only; public counters remain unchanged
reply_hidden_semantics.search_projection: ForumReplyStatusChanged is a canonical Forum Search full-scope source event; category invalidation is also emitted when public counters change
reply_hidden_semantics.atomicity: status, counters/statistics, root/projection events, moderation revision advancement and shared receipt share the adapter owner transaction

reply_rejected_semantics.owner_contract: the established Forum moderator reject_reply action uses ReplyStatus::Rejected and the same validated reply lifecycle
reply_rejected_semantics.already_rejected: no-op without duplicate counters or ForumReplyStatusChanged event
reply_rejected_semantics.other_valid_to_rejected_transitions: status change only; public counters remain unchanged
reply_rejected_semantics.search_projection: ForumReplyStatusChanged is the canonical Forum Search full-scope source event; category invalidation is also emitted when public counters change
reply_rejected_semantics.unpublished_distinction: SetVisibility Unpublished is a separate neutral effect and remains unsupported; it is not mapped to ReplyStatus::Rejected
reply_rejected_semantics.atomicity: status, counters/statistics, root/projection events, moderation revision advancement and shared receipt share the adapter owner transaction

owner_mutations: validate the existing Forum transition to ReplyStatus::Deleted
remove accepted-solution relation when this reply owns it
capture delete revisions through the established Forum soft-delete guards
set status deleted and deleted_at atomically
decrement topic/category/author public reply accounting when the reply was approved
decrement author solution statistics when the removed reply was the accepted solution
reply_removed_semantics.search_projection: ForumReplyStatusChanged remains the canonical Forum Search full-scope source event; category invalidation is also emitted when public counters change
reply_removed_semantics.idempotency: completed Moderation receipt replays before subject reads; an already soft-deleted subject is unavailable rather than re-deleted
reply_removed_semantics.atomicity: soft delete/tombstone, solution cleanup, counters/statistics, root/projection events, moderation revision advancement and shared receipt share the adapter owner transaction

deferred_effects: temporary topic Lock until Forum owns expiry-safe enforcement state
SetVisibility Unpublished until an exact Forum lifecycle mapping is established
ownership: Moderation owns reports cases queues decisions appeals application orchestration operator recovery and cross-domain audit
Forum owns topic/reply lifecycle state moderation subject revision local enforcement and Search projection invalidation
Forum depends on rustok-moderation-api only and does not depend on rustok-moderation
Forum registers neutral subject adapter factories; the selected host composes rustok-moderation and materializes them
forbidden: Forum application recovery state or commands
Forum copy of Moderation decisions or audit log
retargeting a stale decision to a newer Forum revision
reusing Reactions or content revision as the Moderation subject clock
temporary lock without expiry-safe owner state
bypassing ReplyService::remove_in_tx for Moderation Removed reply application
reaction state catalog aggregate or presentation ownership changes
not_claimed: Moderation-owned bespoke polling loop outside the shared ModuleWorkScheduler
typed cross-domain application lifecycle outbox event family
module-owned Moderation admin UI for recovery
automatic replacement decision or silent retargeting after escalation
completion_boundary: FORUM-19 bounded implementation is complete; deployment-dependent promotion is deferred to final production validation and does not reopen implementation unless it exposes a regression
